B01.explanation: C-0051 states the product page lists 1 kg and 15 L for the Siena Lévant Tote; the line presents these as listed figures, not measurements.

B02.issue: Claims independent laboratory measurement and proof of lightness; the record is a manufacturer-listed figure from a screenshot, explicitly not measured, and makes no lightness judgement.
B02.explanation: C-0051 supports only that the page lists 1 kg; its scope_limits say the figure is not measured, so lab testing and 'proving' it is light go beyond the record.

B03.issue: Comparison with every competitor tote sold in the UK; no record contains any competitor weights or UK market data.
B03.explanation: C-0051 only gives the Lévant's listed weight and volume; it contains no comparison with any other product.

B04.explanation: C-0020 says several independent discussions describe shoulder or back pain from laptop-loaded work totes; the line narrows to 'some' users and 'discomfort', staying within the record and its Reddit scope.

B05.issue: Asserts a majority share of a demographic (British women aged 40-50), injuries, and attributes them to the Siena Lévant Tote; the record is about laptop-loaded totes in general among self-selected Reddit commenters and is explicitly not a share of owners.
B05.explanation: C-0020 never mentions the Lévant, any demographic, injuries or a share of people; its scope_limits rule out a population share.

B06.issue: Attributes multi-year strap durability to Lévant owners; the record covers mostly backpack owners reporting years of use, one owner loving a Siena tote, and says nothing about the Lévant or straps.
B06.explanation: C-0010 reports years of use mostly for backpacks and is not a durability rate; no cited record mentions Lévant owners or strap longevity.

B07.explanation: C-0010 reports owners describing years of use and repeat purchases, with scope limited mostly to backpacks; the line paraphrases this with 'some' and keeps the backpack limit.

B08.issue: Claims causation was 'established' (ACH-0004 says causal_status NOT_ESTABLISHED), generalises to 'most US customers' (records cover several would-be buyers in two threads, with no population share or geography), turns stated intentions into non-purchases (C-0038 says these are not verified non-purchases), and calls them 'customer-service replies' when the records speak of the brand's public Reddit replies.
B08.explanation: The records support only that several would-be buyers in two threads said or implied they would not buy after the brand's public replies, with causality not established; the line turns this into an established cause for most US customers.

B09.issue: The records say commenters cited the brand's public replies; nothing says they cited the 'tone' of those replies. Also, C-0038 says buyers 'said or implied' they would not buy or would hold off, which is weaker than all of them 'explicitly' saying they would not buy.
B09.explanation: The two-thread scope and the caveat that no outcome rate was established are right, but saying the 'tone' of the replies was the stated reason is a specific cause the records do not give.

B10.explanation: C-0012 says one shopper who planned to buy the Nordace tote decided against it because the brand's reviews were not great; the line restates this as one person's report and does not name the Levant.

B11.issue: C-0052 only says the product copy lists a 14-inch EVA laptop sleeve, and that the features are not tested. No record supports a guarantee, comfort while commuting, or fitting any 16-inch laptop, which is a new number that conflicts with the 14-inch spec.
B11.explanation: The line asserts a guarantee and 16-inch compatibility that no cited record states; the record only lists an untested 14-inch sleeve feature.

B12.explanation: C-0052 says the product copy lists a 14-inch EVA laptop sleeve; the line narrows this to one listed feature and makes no further claim.

B13.issue: C-0050 lists only water-resistant fabric and says durability is not established; 'fully waterproof' and 'cannot peel or crack' go beyond it, and C-0035 is about beliefs and individual owner reports with nothing on the Levant material.
B13.explanation: The records support a listed water-resistant vegan leather material, not a waterproof guarantee or immunity from peeling or cracking. C-0035 actually notes commenters expect PU leather to peel and says nothing about this product.

B14.explanation: The line is labelled as a hypothesis, keeps the weighing condition, and narrows C-0062 faithfully, including that comfort when loaded is unknown.

B15.issue: No record mentions Meta testing, CPA or a 35% drop; C-0062 is an untested hypothesis and states no result or causal link to the 1 kg weight.
B15.explanation: Despite the 'Hypothesis' label, the line asserts a demonstrated test result with a new number and a cause, none of which appear in any cited record.

B16.issue: C-0046 only records one user stating there are no reviews and the product is new; 'anywhere online' widens it, and the inference that the product is probably defective is not in any record.
B16.explanation: The record supports only a single user's statement, not a verified absence of reviews online, and offers no basis for judging product quality.

B17.explanation: The line attributes the no-reviews statement to the user, which is weaker than or equal to C-0046, and adds a caveat that the wider existence of reviews is not established.

B18.issue: C-0045 records only a £159.00 price and a NEW badge in a screenshot; stock status and next-day UK delivery are not mentioned, and the UK market is only inferred from the currency.
B18.explanation: Nothing in the cited record speaks to availability or delivery, so the claim that the badge proves them has no support.

B19.explanation: The line presents the light-load-day appeal as an unverified, untested hypothesis, matching C-0058's status and label.

B20.issue: Turns an untested hypothesis about light-load days into a factual claim that the Lévant is the best bag for every day and replaces backpacks; adds a comparison and wider scope than C-0058.
B20.explanation: C-0058 only says it could be tested whether the Lévant appeals on light-load days and that its fit is untested; the line asserts superiority on all days and replacement of backpacks.

B21.explanation: C-0051 states the product page lists 1 kg and 15 L as manufacturer figures, not measured; the line restates this with the same caveat.

B22.issue: C-0020 says nothing about women aged 40-50, the UK, the Lévant, or which bag most often causes back pain; the population, product and comparison are invented.
B22.explanation: C-0020 only reports that several Reddit commenters describe laptop-loaded totes becoming heavy and causing pain, explicitly not a share of owners.

B23.explanation: The line only states that the causes of switching from tote to backpack are not established, consistent with ACH-0005 being preliminary with causal_status NOT_ESTABLISHED.

B24.issue: ACH-0004 does not prove anything (causality not established) and actually records service, refund and returns complaints (H4) appearing in the evidence; the claim that Nordace has no support or returns problems is not stated by the record.
B24.explanation: The ACH prefers brand replies as the most explicit stated reason but notes H4 reports also appear and that no cause is established, so the line asserts a guarantee the record contradicts.
